description: As budget-quota-after-deadline-cancel-001, t.0's spent quota strengthens only its Cx's reason to PollQuota after the Deadline cancel at 150. At 200 t.1 notifies it; its notify_wait returns and its checkpoint observes the cancel and acknowledges it, which reconciles the Cx's PollQuota into the record, the cleanup budgets met (reconcile_checkpoint_cancel, record/task.rs:1096-1153); the task returns at the checkpoint.
